sources.title: Directive (EU) 2024/2831 on improving working conditions in platform work
sources.scope: Limits on data processing, worker-representative consultation, human oversight, explanation, review, remedy and health safeguards.
limits: Platform-work scope; Member State transposition is not yet due on the wave date.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act)
sources.scope: Prohibited workplace emotion recognition and high-risk employment-system architecture.
limits: Different provisions have different application dates.

sources.title: AI Act application timeline
sources.scope: Prohibitions applicable since 2025-02-02 and Annex III high-risk employment duties scheduled for 2027-12-02.
limits: Implementation page does not replace the binding regulation text.

sources.title: Works Constitution Act Section 87
sources.scope: Works-council co-determination for technical devices intended to monitor worker behavior or performance.
limits: Application depends on German statutory scope and facts.

sources.title: Works Constitution Act Section 90
sources.scope: Timely information and consultation on technical systems and work processes, including AI.
limits: Consultation and co-determination rights remain statutory and context-specific.

sources.title: Works Constitution Act consolidated text
sources.scope: AI expert assistance, selection-guideline co-determination and related works-council powers.
limits: No claim that these powers exist outside German statutory scope.

sources.title: Workers Statute Article 64.4(d)
sources.scope: Worker-representative information rights concerning parameters, rules and instructions underlying algorithms or AI affecting work and employment.
limits: Does not itself disclose a named employer algorithm.

sources.title: Law 12/2021 on platform delivery work and algorithmic information rights
sources.scope: Legislative enactment of the worker-representative algorithm-information right.
limits: National statutory scope; no universal transparency finding.
